entries.german: Einige gewechselte Schreiben, zwischen Lichtenstein und Rosenberg. Die vorgewesene Marckungs-Versteinung zwischen Ippesheim und Gnezheim betreffend, von Anno 1615. 1618. Von No. 1 biß 5 inclusive
entries.english: A bound file of exchanged letters between Lichtenstein and Rosenberg concerning the boundary marking and erection of boundary stones previously carried out between Ippesheim and Gnezheim, from the years 1615 and 1618, items 1 through 5 inclusive.
